# Crown Watch Co. Complete Enterprise Knowledge Graph & AI System Spec

## Company History & Reputation
Crown Watch Co. was established in 1974 in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Over 50 years of horological experience servicing luxury automatics, quartz timepieces, and digital instruments.

## Watch Repair Services & Pricing
- Battery Replacement: ৳300 - ৳800 BDT (Swiss Silver Oxide / Japanese Maxell battery)
- Glass / Crystal Replacement: ৳800 - ৳2,500 BDT (Mineral Glass or Scratch-Resistant Sapphire)
- Full Automatic Movement Overhaul: ৳2,500 - ৳6,000 BDT (Ultrasonic cleaning, synthetic oil lubrication, timegrapher calibration)
- Water Damage Restoration: ৳1,500 - ৳4,000 BDT

- Inside Dhaka City: ৳60 BDT (Standard 24-48 Hour Delivery)
- Outside Dhaka City (All 64 Districts): ৳120 BDT (Courier Delivery 2-4 Days)
